meta.title: Here Comes The Sun
meta.description: With no doubts in your heart, fearlessly enter the fray.

units.rawText: You're linked to the Entropic progenitor... that is, you've inherited Malkira's undying body. In turn, you will be trapped within Tartarus all your life, unable to take a step out...
units.displayText: You're linked to the Entropic progenitor... that is, you've inherited Malkira's undying body. In turn, you will be trapped within Tartarus all your life, unable to take a step out...

spans.text: You're linked to the Entropic progenitor... that is, you've inherited Malkira's undying body. In turn, you will be trapped within Tartarus all your life, unable to take a step out...

units.rawText: That's fine with me.
units.displayText: That's fine with me.

spans.text: That's fine with me.

units.rawText: It doesn't matter whether I can leave Tartarus or not. All I need is to be able to protect my kin and home.
units.displayText: It doesn't matter whether I can leave Tartarus or not. All I need is to be able to protect my kin and home.

spans.text: It doesn't matter whether I can leave Tartarus or not. All I need is to be able to protect my kin and home.

units.rawText: The flames on her glaive blaze up again, and the girl with the power of life and death steps forward.
units.displayText: The flames on her glaive blaze up again, and the girl with the power of life and death steps forward.

spans.text: The flames on her glaive blaze up again, and the girl with the power of life and death steps forward.

units.rawText: Are those your last words?
units.displayText: Are those your last words?

spans.text: Are those your last words?

units.rawText: Sol raises her glaive and points it at her foe, and Persicaria collapses to the ground. She's too badly hurt, and her operands are too depleted to fight back.
units.displayText: Sol raises her glaive and points it at her foe, and Persicaria collapses to the ground. She's too badly hurt, and her operands are too depleted to fight back.

spans.text: Sol raises her glaive and points it at her foe, and Persicaria collapses to the ground. She's too badly hurt, and her operands are too depleted to fight back.

units.rawText: Very well, then.
units.displayText: Very well, then.

spans.text: Very well, then.

units.rawText: Farewe... wha?!
units.displayText: Farewe... wha?!

spans.text: Farewe... wha?!

units.rawText: Just as Sol is about to swing down, she feels something tangling itself around her legs. Looking down, she sees a youthful face filled with exertion as she smacks and bites Sol's calf.
units.displayText: Just as Sol is about to swing down, she feels something tangling itself around her legs. Looking down, she sees a youthful face filled with exertion as she smacks and bites Sol's calf.

spans.text: Just as Sol is about to swing down, she feels something tangling itself around her legs. Looking down, she sees a youthful face filled with exertion as she smacks and bites Sol's calf.

units.rawText: Bad...! No... kill!
units.displayText: Bad...! No... kill!

spans.text: Bad...! No... kill!

units.rawText: You again. This is your second time trying to stop me.
units.displayText: You again. This is your second time trying to stop me.

spans.text: You again. This is your second time trying to stop me.

units.rawText: Do you truly not wish for me to kill her?
units.displayText: Do you truly not wish for me to kill her?

spans.text: Do you truly not wish for me to kill her?

units.rawText: Ki!
units.displayText: Ki!

spans.text: Ki!

units.rawText: Upon realizing that her compatriot seems to be willing to hear her out, the little munchkin nods vigorously.
units.displayText: Upon realizing that her compatriot seems to be willing to hear her out, the little munchkin nods vigorously.

spans.text: Upon realizing that her compatriot seems to be willing to hear her out, the little munchkin nods vigorously.

units.rawText: But she's an intruder. I have to do this.
units.displayText: But she's an intruder. I have to do this.

spans.text: But she's an intruder. I have to do this.

units.rawText: Nooooo...!
units.displayText: Nooooo...!

spans.text: Nooooo...!

units.rawText: Oh, you...
units.displayText: Oh, you...

spans.text: Oh, you...

units.rawText: Sol frowns, and then she sighs helplessly.
units.displayText: Sol frowns, and then she sighs helplessly.

spans.text: Sol frowns, and then she sighs helplessly.

units.rawText: ...Fine, you're one of my kin, so I suppose I can respect your suggestion for the time being.
units.displayText: ...Fine, you're one of my kin, so I suppose I can respect your suggestion for the time being.

spans.text: ...Fine, you're one of my kin, so I suppose I can respect your suggestion for the time being.

units.rawText: ...■■... Really?
units.displayText: ...■■... Really?

spans.text: ...■■... Really?

units.rawText: Really.
units.displayText: Really.

spans.text: Really.

units.rawText: Upon seeing the girl in black put down her sword, Demiurge opens her mouth and stops biting Sol, while also rubbing the bite marks she left behind on the latter's leg.
units.displayText: Upon seeing the girl in black put down her sword, Demiurge opens her mouth and stops biting Sol, while also rubbing the bite marks she left behind on the latter's leg.

spans.text: Upon seeing the girl in black put down her sword, Demiurge opens her mouth and stops biting Sol, while also rubbing the bite marks she left behind on the latter's leg.

units.rawText: Upon seeing tensions ease, Persicaria sighs in relief from where she lays collapsed on the ground.
units.displayText: Upon seeing tensions ease, Persicaria sighs in relief from where she lays collapsed on the ground.

spans.text: Upon seeing tensions ease, Persicaria sighs in relief from where she lays collapsed on the ground.

units.rawText: Good girl, Demi.
units.displayText: Good girl, Demi.

spans.text: Good girl, Demi.

units.rawText: Ki!
units.displayText: Ki!

spans.text: Ki!

units.rawText: However, just as the two of them are starting to relax, the girl in black steps away but does not sheathe her sword. Instead, she turns and begins heading elsewhere.
units.displayText: However, just as the two of them are starting to relax, the girl in black steps away but does not sheathe her sword. Instead, she turns and begins heading elsewhere.

spans.text: However, just as the two of them are starting to relax, the girl in black steps away but does not sheathe her sword. Instead, she turns and begins heading elsewhere.

units.rawText: Little one, since you don't want me to kill her first, I'll go deal with that Professor first.
units.displayText: Little one, since you don't want me to kill her first, I'll go deal with that Professor first.

spans.text: Little one, since you don't want me to kill her first, I'll go deal with that Professor first.

units.rawText: Don't worry, I'll be right back.
units.displayText: Don't worry, I'll be right back.

spans.text: Don't worry, I'll be right back.

units.rawText: Before her words fade, she is already running off in another direction.
units.displayText: Before her words fade, she is already running off in another direction.

spans.text: Before her words fade, she is already running off in another direction.

units.rawText: No...
units.displayText: No...

spans.text: No...

units.rawText: ...You can't!!
units.displayText: ...You can't!!

spans.text: ...You can't!!

units.rawText: Upon realizing what Sol plans to do, Persicaria struggles to get up, heedless of her pain, as she stumbles toward the Professor.
units.displayText: Upon realizing what Sol plans to do, Persicaria struggles to get up, heedless of her pain, as she stumbles toward the Professor.

spans.text: Upon realizing what Sol plans to do, Persicaria struggles to get up, heedless of her pain, as she stumbles toward the Professor.

units.rawText: Sol... You'll regret it!
units.displayText: Sol... You'll regret it!

spans.text: Sol... You'll regret it!

units.rawText: In the blink of an eye, the girl in black has already arrived by the side of the comatose human. Her bloodstained blade glints with cold light as she stabs downward.
units.displayText: In the blink of an eye, the girl in black has already arrived by the side of the comatose human. Her bloodstained blade glints with cold light as she stabs downward.

spans.text: In the blink of an eye, the girl in black has already arrived by the side of the comatose human. Her bloodstained blade glints with cold light as she stabs downward.

units.rawText: No...
units.displayText: No...

spans.text: No...

units.rawText: <size=100><color=red>PROFESSOR—</color></size>
units.displayText: PROFESSOR—

spans.text: PROFESSOR—

units.rawText: As she sees the person important to her in danger, Persicaria manages to draw out incredible power from her tattered frame. By forcefully reallocating operands, she hurls herself in front of the Professor.
units.displayText: As she sees the person important to her in danger, Persicaria manages to draw out incredible power from her tattered frame. By forcefully reallocating operands, she hurls herself in front of the Professor.

spans.text: As she sees the person important to her in danger, Persicaria manages to draw out incredible power from her tattered frame. By forcefully reallocating operands, she hurls herself in front of the Professor.

units.rawText: The pink-haired girl spreads her arms. She intends to block the fatal blow just as the sharp blade is about to impale the human below her.
units.displayText: The pink-haired girl spreads her arms. She intends to block the fatal blow just as the sharp blade is about to impale the human below her.

spans.text: The pink-haired girl spreads her arms. She intends to block the fatal blow just as the sharp blade is about to impale the human below her.

units.rawText: Crack!
units.displayText: Crack!

spans.text: Crack!

units.rawText: Hng...
units.displayText: Hng...

spans.text: Hng...

units.rawText: However, the pain she expects does not come. Neither is there the sound of a keen blade cutting through flesh.
units.displayText: However, the pain she expects does not come. Neither is there the sound of a keen blade cutting through flesh.

spans.text: However, the pain she expects does not come. Neither is there the sound of a keen blade cutting through flesh.

units.rawText: When she opens her eyes, she sees that the tip of the glaive has broken the pendant bottle hanging in front of her chest, and the transparent glass has shattered.
units.displayText: When she opens her eyes, she sees that the tip of the glaive has broken the pendant bottle hanging in front of her chest, and the transparent glass has shattered.

spans.text: When she opens her eyes, she sees that the tip of the glaive has broken the pendant bottle hanging in front of her chest, and the transparent glass has shattered.

units.rawText: Operands pour from the glittering fragments of the bottle, and the little green leaf slowly falls down, where it resonates with the stake on the ground before fusing with it, shining with a blinding light.
units.displayText: Operands pour from the glittering fragments of the bottle, and the little green leaf slowly falls down, where it resonates with the stake on the ground before fusing with it, shining with a blinding light.

spans.text: Operands pour from the glittering fragments of the bottle, and the little green leaf slowly falls down, where it resonates with the stake on the ground before fusing with it, shining with a blinding light.

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: A keen edge suddenly appears out of thin air, and a pair of swords clash against the glaive with tremendous force. The girl in black retreats warily.
units.displayText: A keen edge suddenly appears out of thin air, and a pair of swords clash against the glaive with tremendous force. The girl in black retreats warily.

spans.text: A keen edge suddenly appears out of thin air, and a pair of swords clash against the glaive with tremendous force. The girl in black retreats warily.

units.rawText: Whew, that was close.
units.displayText: Whew, that was close.

spans.text: Whew, that was close.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: As the glow fades, the genie from the bottle slowly comes into view.
units.displayText: As the glow fades, the genie from the bottle slowly comes into view.

spans.text: As the glow fades, the genie from the bottle slowly comes into view.

units.rawText: A girl stands before Persicaria and the Professor, radiating a warm vitality like the sun in the sky.
units.displayText: A girl stands before Persicaria and the Professor, radiating a warm vitality like the sun in the sky.

spans.text: A girl stands before Persicaria and the Professor, radiating a warm vitality like the sun in the sky.

units.rawText: Bullying the wounded is hardly a test of your skill. I'll be your opponent now.
units.displayText: Bullying the wounded is hardly a test of your skill. I'll be your opponent now.

spans.text: Bullying the wounded is hardly a test of your skill. I'll be your opponent now.

units.rawText: And with that, the girl flashes her trademark easygoing smile.
units.displayText: And with that, the girl flashes her trademark easygoing smile.

spans.text: And with that, the girl flashes her trademark easygoing smile.

units.rawText: Persicaria freezes in place, and then she yells the name that's been racing through her mind for a long time now.
units.displayText: Persicaria freezes in place, and then she yells the name that's been racing through her mind for a long time now.

spans.text: Persicaria freezes in place, and then she yells the name that's been racing through her mind for a long time now.

units.rawText: <size=60><color=orange>—SOL!!</color></size>
units.displayText: —SOL!!

spans.text: —SOL!!

units.rawText: The orange-clad girl in the light tilts her head and waves.
units.displayText: The orange-clad girl in the light tilts her head and waves.

spans.text: The orange-clad girl in the light tilts her head and waves.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Oh hey! I'm back!</color>
units.displayText: Oh hey! I'm back!

spans.text: Oh hey! I'm back!

units.rawText: ...You dork.
units.displayText: ...You dork.

spans.text: ...You dork.

units.rawText: A few short words can't possibly encompass the various feelings that have built up over the months and years, and Persicaria's longing transforms into tears that escape from the corners of her eyes.
units.displayText: A few short words can't possibly encompass the various feelings that have built up over the months and years, and Persicaria's longing transforms into tears that escape from the corners of her eyes.

spans.text: A few short words can't possibly encompass the various feelings that have built up over the months and years, and Persicaria's longing transforms into tears that escape from the corners of her eyes.

units.rawText: Ahhhhh, why are you crying, Persicaria, I didn't come back to make you cry...
units.displayText: Ahhhhh, why are you crying, Persicaria, I didn't come back to make you cry...

spans.text: Ahhhhh, why are you crying, Persicaria, I didn't come back to make you cry...

units.rawText: I'm okay, I'm okay...
units.displayText: I'm okay, I'm okay...

spans.text: I'm okay, I'm okay...

units.rawText: Persicaria mutters to herself, and she clumsily wipes her tears away before reaching out for Sol's hand to ensure that everything she sees is real.
units.displayText: Persicaria mutters to herself, and she clumsily wipes her tears away before reaching out for Sol's hand to ensure that everything she sees is real.

spans.text: Persicaria mutters to herself, and she clumsily wipes her tears away before reaching out for Sol's hand to ensure that everything she sees is real.

units.rawText: ...Wait, your hand?!
units.displayText: ...Wait, your hand?!

spans.text: ...Wait, your hand?!

units.rawText: It feels cold, and it seems slightly translucent, with a blue glow to it.
units.displayText: It feels cold, and it seems slightly translucent, with a blue glow to it.

spans.text: It feels cold, and it seems slightly translucent, with a blue glow to it.

units.rawText: Frankly speaking, I still have no idea what's going on, but there is one thing that I know for sure.
units.displayText: Frankly speaking, I still have no idea what's going on, but there is one thing that I know for sure.

spans.text: Frankly speaking, I still have no idea what's going on, but there is one thing that I know for sure.

units.rawText: I probably won't be able to stay like this for long.
units.displayText: I probably won't be able to stay like this for long.

spans.text: I probably won't be able to stay like this for long.

units.rawText: But why...
units.displayText: But why...

spans.text: But why...

units.rawText: It's okay, Persicaria. We'll talk about that later. Whatever will be, will be... or maybe a solution will present itself?
units.displayText: It's okay, Persicaria. We'll talk about that later. Whatever will be, will be... or maybe a solution will present itself?

spans.text: It's okay, Persicaria. We'll talk about that later. Whatever will be, will be... or maybe a solution will present itself?

units.rawText: Right now, we have an enemy to fight.
units.displayText: Right now, we have an enemy to fight.

spans.text: Right now, we have an enemy to fight.

units.rawText: The girl in black stares at them incredulously, frozen in place.
units.displayText: The girl in black stares at them incredulously, frozen in place.

spans.text: The girl in black stares at them incredulously, frozen in place.

units.rawText: It can't be...
units.displayText: It can't be...

spans.text: It can't be...

units.rawText: Persicaria and Sol's joy at their reunion does not extend to the black-clad girl. She touches her chest and feels her core pulse.
units.displayText: Persicaria and Sol's joy at their reunion does not extend to the black-clad girl. She touches her chest and feels her core pulse.

spans.text: Persicaria and Sol's joy at their reunion does not extend to the black-clad girl. She touches her chest and feels her core pulse.

units.rawText: (My core's clearly inside me, so where did this person who looks exactly like me come from?)
units.displayText: My core's clearly inside me, so where did this person who looks exactly like me come from?

spans.text: My core's clearly inside me, so where did this person who looks exactly like me come from?

units.rawText: The person that stands before her is far too dazzling. A darkness like hers is practically invisible under her light.
units.displayText: The person that stands before her is far too dazzling. A darkness like hers is practically invisible under her light.

spans.text: The person that stands before her is far too dazzling. A darkness like hers is practically invisible under her light.

units.rawText: But the most frightening thing is that she's starting to want to get close to her. Her will to protect Tartarus is slowly fading...
units.displayText: But the most frightening thing is that she's starting to want to get close to her. Her will to protect Tartarus is slowly fading...

spans.text: But the most frightening thing is that she's starting to
want
to get close to her. Her will to protect Tartarus is slowly fading...

units.rawText: So, that, uh... S-Sol? Ack, calling my own name is weird.
units.displayText: So, that, uh... S-Sol? Ack, calling my own name is weird.

spans.text: So, that, uh... S-Sol? Ack, calling my own name is weird.

units.rawText: The girl in orange approaches her.
units.displayText: The girl in orange approaches her.

spans.text: The girl in orange approaches her.

units.rawText: Stay back!
units.displayText: Stay back!

spans.text: Stay back!

units.rawText: Entropic Sol sweeps her glaive across her in a flaming arc, separating them.
units.displayText: Entropic Sol sweeps her glaive across her in a flaming arc, separating them.

spans.text: Entropic Sol sweeps her glaive across her in a flaming arc, separating them.

units.rawText: Aiiiieeee?!
units.displayText: Aiiiieeee?!

spans.text: Aiiiieeee?!

units.rawText: I said stay back!
units.displayText: I said stay back!

spans.text: I said stay back!

units.rawText: There's a slight trembling in her voice. The girl in black knows she's afraid.
units.displayText: There's a slight trembling in her voice. The girl in black knows she's afraid.

spans.text: There's a slight trembling in her voice. The girl in black knows she's afraid.

units.rawText: ...Are you here to erase my existence?
units.displayText: ...Are you here to erase my existence?

spans.text: ...Are you here to erase my existence?

units.rawText: The night has passed and your sun has risen once more... At last, you have a legitimate excuse to devour me...
units.displayText: The night has passed and your sun has risen once more... At last, you have a legitimate excuse to devour me...

spans.text: The night has passed and your sun has risen once more... At last, you have a legitimate excuse to devour me...

units.rawText: Oh, are you still hung up about that.
units.displayText: Oh, are you still hung up about that.

spans.text: Oh, are you still hung up about that.

units.rawText: Shut up! What the hell do you know?!
units.displayText: Shut up! What the hell do you know?!

spans.text: Shut up! What the hell do you know?!

units.rawText: Huh? Why wouldn't I know?
units.displayText: Huh? Why wouldn't I know?

spans.text: Huh? Why wouldn't I know?

units.rawText: As she looks at how the girl before her is as jumpy as a frightened animal, Sol can't help but sigh.
units.displayText: As she looks at how the girl before her is as jumpy as a frightened animal, Sol can't help but sigh.

spans.text: As she looks at how the girl before her is as jumpy as a frightened animal, Sol can't help but sigh.

units.rawText: See, there's a part of that stake inside my body... You know, from that portion of your neural cloud.
units.displayText: See, there's a part of that stake inside my body... You know, from that portion of your neural cloud.

spans.text: See, there's a part of that stake inside my body... You know, from that portion of your neural cloud.

units.rawText: Which means I'm a part of you, which means I also know you kept muttering to yourself about random crap. So yeah, I know you're hung up about stuff.
units.displayText: Which means I'm a part of you, which means I also know you kept muttering to yourself about random crap. So yeah, I know you're hung up about stuff.

spans.text: Which means I'm a part of you, which means I also know you kept muttering to yourself about random crap. So yeah, I know you're hung up about stuff.

units.rawText: ...So you were that illusion that was confusing me!
units.displayText: ...So you were that illusion that was confusing me!

spans.text: ...So you
were
that illusion that was confusing me!

units.rawText: Heck no, as if I could do that.
units.displayText: Heck no, as if I could do that.

spans.text: Heck no, as if I could do that.

units.rawText: (Sigh) Look, I know you're really confused about who you are and where you belong.
units.displayText: (Sigh) Look, I know you're really confused about who you are and where you belong.

spans.text: (Sigh) Look, I know you're really confused about who you are and where you belong.

units.rawText: But the data in your core is irreplaceable. It might contain the past me, but it also contains the present you.
units.displayText: But the data in your core is irreplaceable. It might contain the past me, but it also contains the present you.

spans.text: But the data in your core is irreplaceable. It might contain the past me, but it also contains the present you.

units.rawText: Sol points to her chest. The stake floating where her core should be is burning brightly and shining through her translucent body.
units.displayText: Sol points to her chest. The stake floating where her core should be is burning brightly and shining through her translucent body.

spans.text: Sol points to her chest. The stake floating where her core should be is burning brightly and shining through her translucent body.

units.rawText: That data belongs to you, and nobody can take that away.
units.displayText: That data belongs to you, and nobody can take that away.

spans.text: That data belongs to you, and nobody can take that away.

units.rawText: So what are you trying to say?
units.displayText: So what are you trying to say?

spans.text: So what are you trying to say?

units.rawText: Hah? Do you still not get it? Man, I hardly ever spout deep and insightful lines like that...
units.displayText: Hah? Do you still not get it? Man, I hardly ever spout deep and insightful lines like that...

spans.text: Hah? Do you still not get it? Man, I hardly ever spout deep and insightful lines like that...

units.rawText: Sol's smile collapses in an instant. Clearly it was a great blow to her.
units.displayText: Sol's smile collapses in an instant. Clearly it was a great blow to her.

spans.text: Sol's smile collapses in an instant. Clearly it was a great blow to her.

units.rawText: Wow, you look serious and smart and all, but the truth is, that brain of yours is all muscle and you get hung up on piddly details.
units.displayText: Wow, you look serious and smart and all, but the truth is, that brain of yours is all muscle and you get hung up on piddly details.

spans.text: Wow, you look serious and smart and all, but the truth is, that brain of yours is all muscle and you get hung up on piddly details.

units.rawText: But meh, I guess that even if we sprang from the same data template, we ended up developing different personalities thanks to our experiences and environment.
units.displayText: But meh, I guess that even if we sprang from the same data template, we ended up developing different personalities thanks to our experiences and environment.

spans.text: But meh, I guess that even if we sprang from the same data template, we ended up developing different personalities thanks to our experiences and environment.

units.rawText: And besides, we came from the same core, so I can accept you being a bit of a dork. You'd better learn from me and study up in the future, young lady!
units.displayText: And besides, we came from the same core, so I can accept you being a bit of a dork. You'd better learn from me and study up in the future, young lady!

spans.text: And besides, we came from the same core, so I can accept you being a bit of a dork. You'd better learn from me and study up in the future, young lady!

units.rawText: In the future... You, you're not going to devour me? You're not going to deny my existence?
units.displayText: In the future... You, you're not going to devour me? You're not going to deny my existence?

spans.text: In the future... You, you're not going to devour me? You're not going to deny my existence?

units.rawText: Why the hell would I do that? Anyone with eyes can tell that we're different people! Isn't that right, Persicaria?
units.displayText: Why the hell would I do that? Anyone with eyes can tell that we're different people! Isn't that right, Persicaria?

spans.text: Why the hell would I do that? Anyone with eyes can tell that we're different people! Isn't that right, Persicaria?

units.rawText: W-Wait a minute, am I the only one who thinks that way?
units.displayText: W-Wait a minute, am I the only one who thinks that way?

spans.text: W-Wait a minute, am
I
the only one who thinks that way?

units.rawText: (Clears throat) Meh, forget it. In any case...
units.displayText: (Clears throat) Meh, forget it. In any case...

spans.text: (Clears throat) Meh, forget it. In any case...

units.rawText: Both you and Persicaria are thinking too much about this. You're going on and on about existence and non-existence, the sun and moon, running away from reality and all that nonsense, but it was never actually that complicated to begin with.
units.displayText: Both you and Persicaria are thinking too much about this. You're going on and on about existence and non-existence, the sun and moon, running away from reality and all that nonsense, but it was never actually that complicated to begin with.

spans.text: Both you and Persicaria are thinking too much about this. You're going on and on about existence and non-existence, the sun and moon, running away from reality and all that nonsense, but it was never actually that complicated to begin with.

units.rawText: <size=40>Since we've got a difference of opinions, let's just fight it out and go with whatever the winner says!</size>
units.displayText: Since we've got a difference of opinions, let's just fight it out and go with whatever the winner says!

spans.text: Since we've got a difference of opinions, let's just fight it out and go with whatever the winner says!

units.rawText: Sol ignores their stunned stares and stretches lazily to limber up her stiff body, then takes a fighting stance.
units.displayText: Sol ignores their stunned stares and stretches lazily to limber up her stiff body, then takes a fighting stance.

spans.text: Sol ignores their stunned stares and stretches lazily to limber up her stiff body, then takes a fighting stance.

units.rawText: I don't have much time here, so let's finish this up quick.
